prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Katy, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1099; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just keep it as the claimant for this, if that's alright.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was driving on a main road in Katy, Texas, heading toward the shopping area near the freeway. Traffic had slowed down for a light ahead of me.

Q: What happened next?

A: I came to a stop behind a sedan. Then I felt a hard jolt from behind. My head snapped forward and back, and my car was pushed a few feet into the intersection.

Q: Did the other driver say anything at the scene?

A: They apologized right away. They said they had looked down at their phone for a second and didn't stop in time.

Q: Did you get out of the vehicle?

A: Yes, but I was stiff and sore already. I sat on the curb for a while. My right shoulder was throbbing and I could barely lift my arm.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the accident?

A: Yes. I went to an urgent care clinic that same afternoon, and they told me to follow up with an orthopedic doctor. I've had imaging done and I'm doing physical therapy twice a week.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Has anything else come up that you'd like to add?

A: Only that I've had trouble sleeping and I've missed some work because of the pain. I'm hoping to get back to normal as soon as possible.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
